channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: How Pennsylvania Explains the Forces Shaping the Midterms
item.description: Four battleground congressional districts in the state reveal fault lines that are echoing nationwide.

item.description: Campaign ad spending has topped $10 billion this election cycle, as voters struggle to afford groceries and gas.

item.description: The BBC is on the ground at the Place de la République, where protesters and police clash after weeks of students demonstrations.

item.title: Al Jazeera: Child, four women among Palestinians injured in West Bank pogroms
item.description: Attacks follow a religious edict by a prominent far-right rabbi permitting the seizure of Palestinian olives.

item.title: Ars Technica: Science says your boss should talk less in meetings
item.description: Research suggests listening more while talking less. Killing aimless meetings can help, too.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: cool kids are writing in all lowercase now. does that make you mad?
item.description: a certain kind of person writes in all lowercase now. why?

item.title: WIRED Science: Microplastics React With Water, a New Study Says. That’s a Problem for Biology
item.description: Though plastic is usually inert, tiny pieces of it have the potential to react with one of the most pervasive molecules in the environment and in our bodies.

item.title: WIRED Business: Maybe Chatbots Shouldn’t Get to Say ‘I’ or ‘Me’
item.description: MIT professor Sherry Turkle warns that people have become dangerously enmeshed with chatbots.

item.title: The New Yorker: How Trump’s Immigration Crackdown Gave Florida Democrats a Chance
item.description: A competitive House race in Miami, which leads all American cities in ICE arrests, has revealed how mass deportations have eroded the President’s support among Latinos.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: An Under-$100 North Face Fleece and 35 More Great Deals
item.description: Including cozy clogs from Rothy’s, last-minute Halloween costumes, and humidifiers to get your home ready for winter.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: Janis Joplin Slept Here
item.description: In facing studios at Hotel Chelsea, a pack rat and fountain-show choreographer lives amid memories of his divas.
